name: dotnet
description: Backend .NET : Controller → Service → Dal / Clients, database-first + DbUp

stopChecks.name: migrations : numéros uniques
stopChecks.command: $d = Get-ChildItem backend/db/migrations -Filter *.sql | Group-Object { $_.Name.Split('.')[0] } | Where-Object Count -gt 1; if ($d) { $d | ForEach-Object { "numéro en double : $($_.Name)" }; exit 1 }
